ak-county-officials.area: Alaska — all 19 boroughs and 11 census areas
ak-county-officials.summary: The Borough or Census Area card says whether the place has a borough government, and names none of its mayor or assembly members.
ak-county-officials.why: No list of Alaska's borough officials has been read for this app yet, and the boroughs' own pages have not been read one by one.
ak-county-officials.wanted: A list of each borough's mayor and assembly members, from the state or from the borough itself.

ak-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City card names the city you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
ak-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Alaska's cities has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ak-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's mayor or council members, or a city's own published list of them.

ak-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
ak-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Alaska's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ak-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
